'''100,000,000,000''' ('''one hundred billion''') is the natural number following 99,999,999,999 and preceding 100,000,000,001.

In [[scientific notation]], it is written as 10<sup>11</sup>.

==Selected 12-digit numbers (100,000,000,001–999,999,999,999)==

===100,000,000,001 to 199,999,999,999===
* '''100,000,000,003''' = smallest 12-digit [[prime number]].<ref name="A003617">{{cite OEIS|A003617|Smallest n-digit prime}}</ref>
* '''100,000,147,984''' = 316228<sup>2</sup>, the smallest 12-digit square.
* '''100,000,404,505''' = smallest [[triangular number]] with 12 digits and the 447,214th triangular number
* '''102,280,151,422''' = number of 43-bead binary necklaces with beads of 2 colors where the colors may be swapped but turning over is not allowed<ref name=A000013>{{cite OEIS|A000013|Definition (1): Number of n-bead binary necklaces with beads of 2 colors where the colors may be swapped but turning over is not allowed}}</ref>
* '''107,578,520,350''' = 30th [[Pell number]].<ref name=A000129>{{cite OEIS|A000129|Pell numbers}}</ref>
* '''109,972,410,221''' = number of trees with 32 unlabeled nodes<ref name = A000055>{{cite OEIS|A000055|Number of trees with n unlabeled nodes}}</ref>
* '''127,004,500,762''' = number of parallelogram polyominoes with 32 cells.<ref name=A006958>{{cite OEIS|A006958|Number of parallelogram polyominoes with n cells (also called staircase polyominoes, although that term is overused)}}</ref>
* '''128,367,472,469''' = [[Markov prime]]
* '''134,474,581,374''' = number of secondary structures of RNA molecules with 32 nucleotides<ref name=A004148>{{cite OEIS|A004148|Generalized Catalan numbers}}</ref>
* '''137,438,691,328''' = 7th [[perfect number]].<ref>{{cite OEIS|A000396|Perfect numbers}}</ref>
* '''137,438,953,472''' = 2<sup>37</sup>
* '''139,355,139,206''' = number of signed trees with 20 nodes<ref name=A000060>{{cite OEIS|A000060|Number of signed trees with n nodes}}</ref>
* '''139,583,862,445''' = 55th [[Fibonacci number]].
* '''143,367,113,573''' = Markov prime
* '''145,540,468,640''' = number of series-reduced planted trees with 42 nodes<ref name=A001678>{{cite OEIS|A001678|Number of series-reduced planted trees with n nodes}}</ref>
* '''168,047,007,728''' = number of free 23-ominoes
* '''172,765,826,641''' = Markov prime
* '''186,492,227,801''' = [[self-descriptive number]] in base 11
* '''195,470,831,356''' = number of 45-bead necklaces (turning over is allowed) where complements are equivalent<ref name=A000011>{{cite OEIS|A000011|Number of n-bead necklaces (turning over is allowed) where complements are equivalent}}</ref>
* '''198,585,576,189''' = only known [[Descartes number]]
* '''199,911,300,472''' = number of 44-bead binary necklaces with beads of 2 colors where the colors may be swapped but turning over is not allowed<ref name=A000013/>

===200,000,000,000 to 299,999,999,999===

* '''208,023,278,209''' = 28th [[Motzkin number]].<ref name=A001006>{{cite OEIS|A001006|Motzkin numbers}}</ref>
* '''225,851,433,717''' = 56th Fibonacci number.
* '''247,489,226,192''' = number of centered hydrocarbons with 35 carbon atoms<ref name=A000022>{{cite OEIS|A000022|Number of centered hydrocarbons with n atoms}}</ref>
* '''252,097,800,623''' = 10,000,000,000th prime number
* '''255,323,504,932''' = logarithmic number.<ref>{{cite OEIS|A002104|Logarithmic numbers}}</ref>
* '''259,717,522,849''' = 31st Pell number.<ref name=A000129/>
* '''292,471,210,647''' = highest displayable year on [[64-bit computing]] systems.
* '''293,270,987,832''' = number of parallelogram polyominoes with 33 cells.<ref name=A006958/>

===400,000,000,000 to 499,999,999,999===
* '''410,629,766,416''' = amount of unique coordinate points on [[Earth]] when following the degree, minute, second format. Sum can be found by finding the square of 640,804.

===500,000,000,000 to 999,999,999,999===
* '''500,000,500,000''' = sum of first 1,000,000 integers

* '''695,808,554,300''' = number of signed trees with 21 nodes<ref name="A000060" />

* '''748,607,855,769''' = number of 47-bead necklaces (turning over is allowed) where complements are equivalent<ref name="A000011" />
* '''764,877,836,468''' = number of 46-bead binary necklaces with beads of 2 colors where the colors may be swapped but turning over is not allowed<ref name="A000013" />

* '''823,779,631,721''' = number of trees with 34 unlabeled nodes<ref name="A000055" />
* '''845,139,060,165''' = number of secondary structures of RNA molecules with 34 nucleotides<ref name="A004148" />

* '''918,212,890,625''' = 1-[[automorphic number]]<ref>{{cite OEIS|A003226|Automorphic numbers: m^2 ends with m.}}</ref>
* '''956,722,026,041''' = 59th Fibonacci number.
* '''999,999,999,989''' = largest 12-digit prime number<ref name="A003618">{{cite OEIS|A003618|Largest n-digit prime}}</ref>
